scope: FinBench SF0.1 facts, authored finite-intent interaction tasks; not official FinBench scores or open-NL evaluation
truth_selection: hash(seed, scenario, within-scenario index) modulo family size; independent of method outcomes
answer_stratification: 3 nonempty and 1 empty per scenario, determined only by independent CSV reference; not a random sample of all FinBench queries
exclusion: all anchors in the previously frozen one-shot population plus authored primary workload; no old case replay
time_window: full snapshot transfer-time range; inclusive flags are intent coordinates

timing_repeat.case_rule: first predeclared case of each scenario

order: Williams order over six configurations for first pass; reverse matching order for the four-case repeat; one fresh service per case group, no query warmup
censoring: all failures and safe non-answers retained; global budget leaves remaining cells unrun; repeated measurements never increase question count
no_claims: OR-count scalability from confounded scenario groups
